replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
The senior staff team as well as whomever is in charge of "advertising" and "fixing up this server" have no say in what the Map Dev team chooses to do for the community, we're all working very hard to cleanup some things and a new hub is just one step of the way to putting Avicus back on it's feet. 

Remember that the Map Dev team and senior staff work indirectly from one another in our respective positions, keep in mind there's only so much we can do compared to the Senior staff team

A new hub is the least we can do for the community c: 

Oh and, this hub is going to be in use for quite longer than the previous hubs.
